label: GPT-6 Luna
output:
Priya,

I read your note, and I want you to know I’m not throwing you under the bus with Greg. He’s going to be mad either way, and I’ll handle that conversation. This isn’t all on you—the questionnaire library is a mess, and nobody owns keeping it current. You’ve been great on this account, including staying until 9 in September to rebuild the demo environment when the route import broke. One copy-paste mistake doesn’t erase that, so please don’t beat yourself up.

I’m not going to pretend I’m not stressed. Brazos is $186k ARR on a three-year term, and I’ve been working it since February. It’s the biggest deal of my year. I’ve already told my wife we’d finally take that Big Bend trip off the commission, so yes, I’m feeling the stakes. But I think this is fixable if we’re honest and move quickly. Dana seems strict but fair.

Can you correct Q14 tonight to state the actual Type I status and that the Type II audit window closes January 31, with the report expected in March? Please send the corrected answer to me first—not Dana—so we can review it together.

I spoke with Marcus on Security. He can join a call with Dana and their legal team Thursday at 2, and he says we can offer a bridge letter from the auditor. I’d like you on that call too so we can walk them through the status and timeline clearly.

We’ll take this one step at a time and fix it together. Thanks for owning the mistake and being ready to help get us back on track.

Jordan
